import numpy as np

def export_and_optimize(model, sample_input, output_path):
    # Export
    torch.onnx.export(model, sample_input, output_path, opset_version=17, do_constant_folding=True)
    # Optimize
    onnx_model = onnx.load(output_path)
    optimized = onnxoptimizer.optimize(onnx_model)
    onnx.save(optimized, output_path)
    # Verify
    original_output = model(sample_input).detach().numpy()
    sess = onnxruntime.InferenceSession(output_path)
    onnx_output = sess.run(None, {'input': sample_input.numpy()})[0]
    assert np.allclose(original_output, onnx_output, atol=1e-5)
    return output_path
